what: The text of a proposed 'Why this exists' page, linked from the masthead and every byline. Its points follow the UX review's list; the wording is a draft for Dinis to change. 'Who it is for' is not written here: the page generates it from data/newsroom/personas.json and the neutral persona file.
source: context/newsroom-ux-review.md, 'The direction: a publication with a heart' ('Write a purpose page'); participant disclosure quoted from the live homepage footer, 11 Oct 2026
title: Why this exists
standfirst: A publication about AI agents, security and the next generation of publishing, written in the open by Dinis Cruz with a desk of agents. This page says what it is for, what it is not, and what I would like from you.
pull: Every idea here is free to take, adapt and build on.

sections.label: The agenda
points: Share what I know, as I learn it, with the evidence attached.
Solve real problems in the open, so the method can be checked and copied.
Build sgit.ai and RiskMandate. Most of these articles use them as evidence, and I have a stake in both.
sections.disclosure: Participant disclosure: published by the sgit project, which is building the stack this site argues for.
sections.disclosure_note: Moved here from the footer, where it sits on the live site today.

sections.label: Open by default
sections.lede: Nothing here is behind a licence you have to ask about.
points: Content is CC BY 4.0: copy it, translate it, quote it, build on it, and say where it came from.
Every idea here is free to take, adapt and build on.

sections.label: How it is written
sections.lede: The words start as my voice notes.
points: A desk of named agents turns the notes into articles, under rules that are published.
Every version is kept, so you can see what changed and when.
The method is published so anyone can run a newsroom like it. It lives in the workshop, not on the front page.

sections.label: Who it is for
sections.lede: Each persona is a front page made for one kind of reader. Pick the one closest to you.

sections.label: What I want from you
sections.lede: Four things, in rising order of commitment.

actions.label: Read
actions.text: Start with your persona's first article.

actions.label: Rate
actions.text: Tell me whether a piece was useful. One tap, with your consent.

actions.label: Tell me what is missing
actions.text: The article you wanted and did not find.

actions.label: Put your agents on a problem
actions.text: If a problem here is yours, ask about putting your agents on it.
